title: Ewen Cameron examines Rudolf Hess to see whether he was a double

tellings.quote: figure out is this really Herman Hess or is it a double? Right.

plain: In England in the 1940s, the psychiatrist Ewen Cameron was brought in to examine Rudolf Hess, one of the top Nazi leaders. His job was to work out whether the prisoner really was Hess or a double. The author Peter Levenda tells this on Michels's show without naming a source. If the man was a double, the person in custody was not who the world believed he was.
